plan.name: Marathon Goal 4h30
plan.description: Complete 16-week training plan to finish a marathon in 4h30. Designed for safe progression with 4 weekly sessions.

cycles.name: Cycle 1: General Preparation
cycles.description: Getting started, developing fundamental endurance, and introducing speed work.

sessions.name: Easy Run
sessions.description: 45 min fundamental endurance. Total breathing comfort.

sessions.name: Long Run
sessions.description: 1h10 endurance. Do not run fast, the goal is duration.

sessions.name: Run + Variations
sessions.description: 45 min including 3 speed variations of 2 min.

sessions.name: Pace Reminder
sessions.description: 15' warmup + 10' a bit faster (Marathon Pace) + 10' cooldown.

cycles.name: Cycle 2: Specific Development
cycles.description: Increasing long run duration and working at target paces.

sessions.name: 30/30 Intervals
sessions.description: 20' warmup + 2x(8x 30s fast / 30s slow) R=3' + 10' cooldown. To develop engine capacity.

sessions.name: Threshold Session
sessions.description: 20' warmup + 3x 8 min at threshold (10km/Half pace) R=2' + 10' cooldown.

sessions.name: Long Run
sessions.description: 1h50 Pure endurance. Accustom the body to duration.

sessions.name: Pyramid
sessions.description: Fartlek: 20' warmup + 2'-4'-6'-4'-2' fast / R= half time + 10' cooldown.

sessions.name: Long Run
sessions.description: 2h15 endurance. This is long, hydrate well.

sessions.name: The Longest Run
sessions.description: 2h30 including 3x 15min Marathon Pace. Test your race nutrition.

sessions.name: Threshold
sessions.description: 20' warmup + 20 min threshold + 3' recovery + 10 min threshold + 10' cooldown.

cycles.name: Cycle 3: Taper & Race
cycles.description: Drastic volume reduction to arrive fresh on race day.

sessions.name: Light Speed
sessions.description: 15' warmup + 8x 1min fast / 1min slow + 10' cooldown. Just to turn the legs over.

sessions.name: Shakeout Run
sessions.description: 30 min very slow to get blood flowing.

sessions.name: Day Before Race (Optional)
sessions.description: 15 min ultra slow jog or REST.

sessions.name: MARATHON
sessions.description: Race Day. Goal 4h30. Start conservatively (6:24/km) and enjoy!
